name: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was formerly known as Columbus Circle Capital Corp II and changed its name to Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII in August 2026. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in New York, New York.
